newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF says hasn't heard of problems at insurers-Jiji.
newsitem.headline: MOF says hasn't heard of problems at insurers-Jiji.

text.p: Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said he had not heard about problems at particular insurance firms but added that his ministry will try its best to protect policyholders at troubled insurers, Jiji new agency reported on Friday.

"I have not received any reports about any particular firms but we have said that we will try our best to protect depositors in the case of banks, and policyholders in the case of life insurers," Mitsuzuka was quoted as saying by Jiji.
It said he was responding to question about media reports that the ministry was preparing to order financially troubled Nissan Mutual Life Insurance Co to halt operations.
Jiji and other media said earlier on Friday that the ministry would issue the order in a few days.
Nissan Life, an unlisted company, said it would hold a news conference at 1.30 p.m. (0430 GMT) on Friday on an order by the ministry to stop its operations.
